label: GO after a rewarded trial, with a strong commitment to a2
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew input 0 at GO, but prev_reward==1 carries 99.8% of mass) and the agent is about to choose a2 (58582 of 58588 activations have action==2; model_act==2). Mass is concentrated where the policy logit strongly favours a2 (choice < -8.9 holds 97% of mass): essentially a2-stay after a reward (prev_action a2, usually common to S2, good=S2). It never fires at D1 or D2, never before a1 choices, almost never after unrewarded trials. Rate rises sharply late in the episode (trials 60+), tracking a more extreme a2 logit, and is higher at lower value. The magnitude grows with how negative the choice logit is: choice < -9.3 gives precision 0.93 and choice < -10 precision 1.0 but low recall. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables plus the model own policy logit at the same step; the closest input-only form (GO & prev_reward==1 & action==2, the agent own upcoming choice) gives recall 0.98 but precision 0.44. Precision is incomplete because many confident rewarded-a2 GO steps do not cross threshold.
